standing: Use the selected skill roles with current actor, purpose, owner policy and actual operation checks

roles.personal-index: Optional acting-user discovery preferences and catalog references
roles.knowledge-wiki: Retained source/claim/synthesis and reviewed contribution home
roles.entity-home: Current authoritative business records or selected home for new records
roles.method-settings: Applicable methods/domain requirements/settings; separate from content
roles.artifact-home: Exact rendered outputs and inspection evidence
roles.feedback-drafts: Sanitized product proposals; no publication implied

output_rule: Resolve delivery mode/home early from the explicit choice, current entity home and applicable adopted workflow instruction; chat-only/read-only scope causes no unsolicited write.
